jobs.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached exact UI reference. Production Unity UI asset, NOT a mockup. Extract ONLY its horizontal five-tab purple bottom navigation BACKPLATE. Remove ALL five icons and the word Mapa, remove the grass, trees, phone, black background, and everything outside the backplate. Replace removed icons with uninterrupted original smooth purple surfaces. Preserve the exact proportions of the reference: entire backplate width to height = 1300:245, FIVE EQUAL touching cells, gently rounded lower OUTER corners only, small top corners. Absolutely preserve the original premium painted 3D molded finish: each card has a THIN but visibly lit rounded top bevel, narrow soft inner shadow under that bevel, fine light-purple side edge, narrow recessed purple seams, lively vertical violet gradient becoming deep purple below. The continuous gold frieze MUST match the reference: distinct pale lemon-yellow upper rounded face and amber-gold lower face, thin cream specular reflection near the top and short amber shadow below, about 14px thick at a bar width of 1300px. No added ornaments, no particles, no external glow, no thick outlines. Front view, no perspective. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the clean bar silhouette. Frame the entire bar almost filling a VERY WIDE canvas (about 1536 x 300), with only a tiny uniform transparent safety margin. NO icons, NO text, NO lettering, NO symbols, NO logos. Do not redraw any other part of the screen. All FIVE cards must have the exact DEEP PURPLE color/gradient/finish of the four UNSELECTED cards in the reference. Change the first lilac card to match the other four. All five cards unselected, all the same violet-purple color. This is the reusable inactive background.
